review:
Chilli Heat Spicy Spins revolves around a respin round on its own 5x5 grid. Three scatters trigger it, replacing the reels with a board where only money symbols and blanks can land. Money symbols stick until the end, and each new one resets the respin counter to three.

The clever part is the group multiplier. Money symbols that are horizontally or vertically connected form groups, and bigger groups earn bigger multipliers: Pragmatic Play's page lists steps from 2x for four to six symbols up to 50x for a group of 24, while the game's intro screen promises multipliers of up to 800x in respins, so check the paytable in the demo for the exact values. At the end, every value is multiplied accordingly. Filling all 25 positions awards the 10,000x maximum. The RTP of 96.58% is strong.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
